title: Space/join ignores SpaceBan
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 Space/join: server 'MUST verify that no active SpaceBan exists ... MUST reject the request with a forbidden method error'; 1e33ec7 fixes order: argument check (invalidArguments), Space resolution (inviteCode invalidArguments / spaceId notPermitted), then ban and closed checks (forbidden). space.rs:1421-1596 never looks up bans; a banned user can rejoin. Ban MUST predates 1e33ec7; ordering is new. notPermitted part is JMAP-yt1w.1(6), closed part JMAP-yt1w.4(c). Found by the 1e33ec7 audit (wf_af4656ea-dbb, both refuters upheld). Fix with a failing test quoting the draft; extend chat_client_wire.rs where the client exercises it.
notes: fix done in 584910de: tests added space_join_public_space_banned_forbidden, space_join_via_invite_banned_forbidden, space_join_expired_ban_does_not_block, space_join_argument_check_precedes_ban_check (chat-server integration.rs); space_join_rejects_banned_caller (testjig chat_client_wire.rs). yt1w.1(6) notPermitted NOT done here; yt1w.1(6) still owns it.
close_reason: Fixed against jmap-chat-spec 1e33ec7; test-first, reviewed, gates green (stable/beta/1.88)
